answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and said 100% of the new capacity was pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. The company targeted US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. No dollar size is stated for the capacity itself. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures in the article ($485.5m/$47.9m from NN's narrative, and about $489.5m/$48.3m from unnamed analysts) are third-party projections for 2028, a different period and definition from the 2026 company target, so they do not update any 2026 figure. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal in late June 2026 is a fact reported by finance.yahoo.com with no stated effect on the investment case in the texts. Publication day is 2026-07-01 and the original announcement day is not stated.
